issues.on_page: Charges for services 22,642 = Park 50 + Pool 7,242 + Community Building 15,350 (p15)
issues.issue: The combining statement prints this line's breakdown. Under the user's rules, the 7,292 from Park and Pool is Recreation Fees (the detail already uses that), and Community Building charges of 15,350 (68%) are probably building rentals. The line could be split with split_from. The same question applies to detail[9] (Community Building 15,350, other charges for services).
TIF proceeds are property tax increment passed to the CDA. Property tax is defensible, but this is a judgment call (already marked review).
